diagnosis: Job EXP-40233 (approx. 6 GB) has run for about seven hours, which exceeds the six-hour stall threshold in kb-0005. Per that article the job is stalled and the customer should cancel it and resubmit; queues are per region, so resubmission re-enters the eu-central queue. Policy decided no escalation, so handle with standard guidance.
reply: Thanks for reporting this. A 6 GB export would normally complete within about an hour, and any job showing as running for more than six hours is considered stalled. Please cancel job EXP-40233 and resubmit it; export jobs are queued per region, so the new job will re-enter the eu-central queue. If the resubmitted job again runs past six hours, let us know and we can take another look.
